```python
    return sum(dp[n]) % MOD
```

This solution has a time complexity of O(n * 26) and a space complexity of O(n * 26), where n is the length of the input string S. It calculates the number of distinct subsequences of S by building up a table dp[i][j], where dp[i][j] is the number of distinct subsequences of the first i characters of S, where the last character is j. The final answer is the sum of all the entries in the last row of the table, modulo 10^9 + 7.
